Container.Name: paseo-container
Container.Overview:
Runs the Paseo daemon with Claude Code and Codex. Connect from the Paseo desktop and phone apps through Paseo's end-to-end encrypted relay, or on the LAN on port 6767. Agents keep running when every app disconnects.
After the first boot, pair a device with: docker exec -it -u paseo -e PASEO_HOME=/config/paseo paseo-container paseo daemon pair
Exclude this container from automatic updates and from backups that stop containers: a restart interrupts any agent turn that is running.

Config.Name: Paseo
Config.Description: Paseo API, web UI, and LAN direct connections.

Config.Name: SSH
Config.Description: SSH port. Connect with: ssh -p 2223 paseo@[IP]

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Paseo state, the relay keypair, worktrees, agent logins, SSH keys, and tools.

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: Your source repositories. Mounted inside the home directory so the apps can suggest folders from it.

Config.Name: PASEO_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for LAN direct connections. Leave empty and the container generates one in /config/paseo/password.

Config.Name: PASEO_HOSTNAMES
Config.Description: Extra host names the daemon accepts, comma-separated, for example tower.local. IP addresses always work.

Config.Name: SSH_PUBKEY
Config.Description: Your SSH public key. SSH logins need a key, because password authentication is disabled. You can leave it empty when SSHD_ENABLED is 0 or /config/ssh/authorized_keys already holds your key.

Config.Name: AGENTS
Config.Description: Comma-separated coding agents to install on boot. Supported: claude, codex.

Config.Name: GIT_USER_NAME
Config.Description: Seeds git user.name on the first boot.

Config.Name: GIT_USER_EMAIL
Config.Description: Seeds git user.email on the first boot.

Config.Name: GIT_TOKEN
Config.Description: Access token for pushing. Seeds /config/git/credentials on the first boot.

Config.Name: GIT_TOKEN_HOST
Config.Description: Host that GIT_TOKEN authenticates to.

Config.Name: GH_TOKEN
Config.Description: Token for the GitHub CLI. Optional when you sign in with gh auth login.

Config.Name: NPM_TOOLS
Config.Description: npm packages to install into /config/tools.

Config.Name: PYTHON_TOOLS
Config.Description: PyPI packages to install into /config/tools with uv, for example python-openstackclient.

Config.Name: BIN_TOOLS
Config.Description: Single-binary tools as name=url pairs separated by spaces, for example kubectl=https://dl.k8s.io/release/v1.34.1/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl. Append #sha256=HEX to verify a download.

Config.Name: HOME_PERSIST
Config.Description: Home-directory paths kept in /config/home across recreates.

Config.Name: APT_PACKAGES
Config.Description: Debian packages to install on every boot. Keep the list short.

Config.Name: AGENT_UPDATE
Config.Description: Set to 1 for one boot to reinstall every agent.

Config.Name: TOOL_UPDATE
Config.Description: Set to 1 for one boot to reinstall every tool.

Config.Name: SSHD_ENABLED
Config.Description: Set to 0 to boot without SSH.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns files. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns files. 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for Paseo, its agents, and SSH shells.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone, for example Europe/Oslo.
